scope: Post-seal assessment-only field forward audit, never estimator inputs
queries: Use the exact frozen48 queries from each selected raw image
arms: full retained acoustic reference mesh at true recorded body/sonar poses
same full mesh at recorded sensor-navigation poses under the existing evaluation gauge
sealed finite height_diverse_fit at recorded navigation poses (already retained)
material: Uniform .001 per triangle; profile one positive common brightness gain per view in every arm. No per-pixel gain, threshold or sensor change.
retention: Complete selected power, exact mean/covariance, predicted range grid/source-normal outputs, first-hit inventory, all missing-pose cases. Reuse original raw, scene and truth files by hash.
interpretation: Compare full scene vs finite family at identical nav pose; compare true vs nav pose with identical full scene. If true-scene/true-pose prediction also fails, audit reference inventory, rasterization and time/geometry convention before inverse mapping. These paired source-model conditions are diagnostic, not a hardware calibration or new field.
pose_time_policy: Linear translation and quaternion Slerp of original bracketing body truth at raw acquisition stamp; retain bracket IDs and offsets, require gap<=0.1s, no extrapolation or fitted time offset. Exact-stamp matches stay exact. The earlier nearest<=25ms context proof is not relabeled exact.
